components.name: Ovation - 42" Hybrid Grill w/ grill liner
components.description:
The new 42" Built-In Ovation Hybrid Grill expands the refined design language of the Ovation Series, offering increased cooking space while maintaining its balanced, architectural presence. It brings together the clean front aesthetic inspired by the Estate Series with the depth and strength of a hybrid platform, creating a grill that feels both elevated and performance-driven.

Crafted from #304 stainless steel, the Ovation 42" delivers full multi-fuel capability, allowing you to cook with gas, charcoal, hardwood, and more. This flexibility gives you the freedom to shape the flavor and cooking style to the moment. The expanded cooking surface supports larger meals and multiple zones, while interior halogen lighting and a rotisserie back burner extend your capabilities into the evening.

As a built-in centerpiece, the Ovation 42" anchors the outdoor kitchen with a refined presence that complements custom spaces. It's designed for those who want more room to cook, greater versatility in how they cook, and a grill that balances performance and visual appeal.

components.name: Hestan 15" Outdoor Ice Machine LF
components.description:
15" Hestan Outdoor Ice Machine – GIM Series - GIM_15

The Hestan ice machine is the life of the party – producing up to 55 pounds of crystal-clear ice every 24 hours. The 22-pound capacity ensures you always have plenty of ice on hand.

- Crystal-clear top hat ice makes every drink more refreshing.
- 22-pound capacity ensures you always have plenty of ice on hand.
- 55 pounds of fresh ice are produced every 24 hours.
- Heavy-duty insulation keeps ice perfectly chilled.
- Air-cooled, self-contained, built-in storage bin is constructed from heavy-gauge stainless steel.
- Adjustable leveling legs.
- UL and NSF certified for outdoor use.
- Left- and right-hinged models available.
- Drain pump available.

components.name: Hestan 24" Outdoor Undercounter Refrigerator Solid Door RH -Pacific Fog
components.description:
24" Hestan Outdoor Undercounter Refrigerator (Solid Door) – GRSR Series - GRS_24

The Hestan undercounter refrigerator offers flexible cold storage for ingredients and refreshments. Heavy-duty insulation and forced-air refrigeration system creates optimum storage. Available in a stainless steel door or glass door to fit your outdoor kitchen needs.

- 33°F to 42°F temperature control gives you the flexibility to store cold drinks for your guests or fresh fish for the grill.
- Adjustable, full-extension pullout shelves accommodate everything from platters to bottles.
- Heavy-duty insulation and forced-air refrigeration system creates optimum storage.
- LED interior lighting makes it easy to find what you need.
- Stainless steel front, sides and interior (convertible door design allows for wood overlay)
- Stainless steel or glass front door (low E, UV-coated glass provides industry leading insulation and protection).
- Front-vented, forced-air refrigeration system maintains optimum cold storage.
- 5.2 cubic feet of storage capacity accommodates more than enough burgers to fill the grill.
- Locking doors keep everything secure.
- Adjustable leveling legs and zero clearance hinging.
- UL certified for outdoor use.
- Left- and right-hinged models available.
- Caster kit available.

components.name: Hestan 24" Outdoor Power Burner -Steeletto
components.description:
Hestan 24" Outdoor Power Burner -Steeletto

FEATURES
Sealed burner bowl with drain protects from boilovers and spills, and the stainless steel removable drip tray allows for easy cleaning.
Stainless steel top cover provides extra protection from the elements.

components.name: Hestan 24" Outdoor Dual Zone Refrigerator with Wine Storage LH -Pacific Fog
components.description:
24" Hestan Outdoor Dual Zone Refrigerator w/Wine Storage (Solid Door) – GRWS Series - GRS_24

The dual zone refrigerator offers two independent temperature zones so you can store both reds and whites at optimum temperature. Full-extension wine racks keep your wines safe from vibration while the stainless steel door keeps out harmful sunlight.

- Two temperature zones with precision control create the perfect environment for your wines – from 33°F to 42°F in the bottom zone and 45°F to 65°F in the top zone.
- Three full-extension pullout wine storage shelves protect wine from vibration and deliver easy access.
- Solid stainless steel front door provides industry-leading insulation and protection from sunlight.
- Front-vented, forced-air refrigeration system maintains optimum cold storage.
- 5.0 cubic feet of storage capacity accommodates more than enough wine.
- Locking doors keep your collection secure.
- Adjustable leveling legs and zero clearance hinging.
- UL certified for outdoor use.
- Left- and right-hinged models available.
- Caster kit available.

components.name: 24" Undercounter Built-In Drawer Refrigerator – Stainless Steel/Bronze | Gordon Ramsay Series
components.description: The RF24U is a 24-inch stainless steel refrigerator with 5.4 cu ft (152 L) of cooling capacity and two soft-close drawers, designed for both indoor and outdoor use. The unit is available as built-in or freestanding, has an anti-fingerprint finish.

components.name: Thor Kitchen 32" Outdoor Kitchen GAS BBQ GRILL With 4 Burners
components.description: THOR Kitchen offers the power and performance of a premium pro-style appliance at a practical price. The THOR Kitchen 32 Inch 4-Burner Gas Grill is designed to sit on top of and connect to our 32 Inch Grill Cabinet (not included). This powerful grill has one 13,000 BTU infrared burner and three 12,000 BTU tube burners, giving you full control to create hot and cool areas on your ‘que. It also features a 10,000 BTU rear infrared rotisserie burner, because rotating a bird keeps it juicy. The brilliant blue LED knob lights add a bold, stylish touch to your outdoor set up. #IgniteYourCulinaryCreativity

components.name: 36" 4-Burner Built-In Gas Grill with Sear/Rear Infrared Burner & Rotisserie
components.description: The THOR Kitchen TPG3601-G is a 36-inch professional built-in gas grill engineered for outdoor culinary excellence, featuring three cast stainless steel burners along with an infrared and rear ceramic rotisserie burner that deliver a potent 84,000 BTU total heat output for versatile grilling and searing. Designed with ceramic briquette heat control grids to promote even heat distribution and reduce flare-ups, a double-wall 304 stainless steel hood for enhanced heat retention and durability, and interior halogen lighting paired with illuminated control knobs for better visibility during low-light cooking. Additional conveniences include a built-in temperature gauge, warming rack with hook storage, and foldable side shelves, making this built-in grill a powerful and user-friendly centerpiece for outdoor kitchens.

components.name: 32" Built-in Gas Grill | Gordon Ramsay Collection
components.description: Why limit great grilling to special days? Every day is perfect for firing up and enjoying outdoor flavor. This 32 Inch Built-In Grill delivers 66,000 BTUs of powerful heat, even cooking thanks to ceramic briquette grids, and intuitive controls that give you full command. Crafted to complement your outdoor kitchen, it combines rugged durability, professional performance, and sleek design—turning every meal into a memorable cookout.

components.name: 15" Undercounter Built-In/Freestanding Ice Maker in Stainless Steel/Rose Gold | Gordon Ramsay Series

components.name: 24" Dual Zone Wine/Beverage Cooler RH
components.description: Fire Magic’s® Premium Wine Cooler blends seamlessly into your Fire Magic® outdoor kitchen while keeping beverages chilled to perfection. Custom designed with two chilling zones for storing wine and beverages at different temperatures. A handsome glass door allows you to choose your beverage without letting out the cold. Handy lock keeps contents safe. Must be installed in an enclosure when used outdoors.

components.name: 24" Dual Zone Wine/Beverage Cooler LH
components.description: Fire Magic’s® Premium Wine Cooler blends seamlessly into your Fire Magic® outdoor kitchen while keeping beverages chilled to perfection. Custom designed with two chilling zones for storing wine and beverages at different temperatures. A handsome glass door allows you to choose your beverage without letting out the cold. Handy lock keeps contents safe. Must be installed in an enclosure when used outdoors.

components.name: 24" Double Drawer Cold Storage
components.description: Fire Magic’s® family-friendly double drawer cooler is set to elevate your outdoor beverage experiences, making it the perfect companion for gatherings, barbecues, and family fun. Crafted from sleek and sturdy stainless steel, it not only keeps your canned and bottled beverages perfectly chilled but also provides ample space for food that’s eagerly awaiting its turn on the grill.

components.name: Double Trash Cabinet
components.description:
The Fire Magic Premium Double Trash Cabinet is a remarkable combination of functionality and elegance. Constructed from resilient 304 stainless steel, this cabinet offers a soft-close operation and a secure magnetic latch for ease of use. With designated bins for organized waste management, its design embodies quality craftsmanship made proudly in the USA.

Durable 304 Stainless Steel construction
• Handsome design closes flush with the frame
• Filled with polyurethane foam for insulation, durability, strength, and solidity
• Soft close on almost all doors and drawers prevents slamming – for a gentle and secure close
• Continuous rain guard (or gasket) protects from water getting into your enclosure

components.name: Flush Single Griddle Drawer
components.description:
Durable 304 stainless steel single griddle drawer provides lasting strength and convenient storage for any outdoor kitchen. This beautiful utility drawer is wider than the single drawer. Perfect to fit a cooking griddle accessory or a utensil drawer for
convenient backyard grilling.
• Handsome design closes flush with the frame
• Filled with polyurethane foam for insulation, durability, strength, and solidity
• Soft close on almost all doors and drawers prevents slamming – for a gentle and secure close
• Continuous rain guard (or gasket) protects from water getting into your enclosure

components.name: 30" X 21" Double Door Ranch  SS
components.description:
FEATURES

- Black 304 Stainless Steel Finish
- Built-In Design

components.name: Built In Outdoor Induction Cooker
components.description:
Elevate your outdoor cooking experience with our state-of-the-art, newly built Outdoor Induction Cooktop. Perfect for grilling, tailgating, or backyard gatherings, this sleek, portable cooktop delivers precision, power, and efficiency, all while maintaining a safe and easy-to-use design.

Built-In Outdoor Induction Cooker Features:

Certified for outdoor use
Automatic recognition of pan size and type
Durable 5mm thick tempered glass construction
Seven power mode levels
A 600-minute timer
Highly visible LED power/temp display, with temperature provided in °F
Built-in, touch-sensitive digital thermostat control
Power ON/OFF touch pad with indicator light
Over or under voltage protection
Stainless-steel cover to product the cooktop when not in use
Temperatures ranging from 120°F to 450°F

components.name: Aurora Built-In Griddle
components.description:
The Aurora built-in griddle is designed to complete an outdoor kitchen suite of Aurora products. The griddle is perfect for outdoor cooking of everything from fried rice to fajitas to bacon and eggs. The expansive 30” x 18” cooking surface is powered by dual stainless steel burners providing up to 45,000 BTUs. A stainless steel cover is included and the griddle has the same cut out dimensions as an A660 grill or pizza oven.

Feature Highlights

304 Stainless Steel construction
Expansive 30″ x 18″ cooking area
3/8″ thick stainless steel griddle surface for years of warp-free performance
Dual heavy-duty stainless steel burners providing 45,000 BTUs
Hot surface ignition and two back-lit control knobs to provide two-zone cooking
Two-piece drip collector trough over two ports that funnel excess grease into the drip pan
Same cut-out dimensions as the A660i grill
Easily removable stainless steel griddle cover.
Optional Portable Cart Grill Base (sold separately) is available if a portable option is desired. Use part #660-SC24

components.name: Echelon E540d Drop In Grill
components.description:
Feast your eyes on the Fire Magic Echelon Drop-In Gas Grill—a true centerpiece of outdoor culinary luxury. Now available in a 30” drop-in model, this grill combines cutting-edge design with premium performance. The sleek new hood and modern black glass accent on the control panel elevate its sophisticated look, while the built-in analog thermometer ensures precise temperature control for exceptional grilling results. Crafted with the superior quality and attention to detail that define the Echelon Series, this grill is designed to impress both in style and in performance, making it a standout addition to any luxury outdoor kitchen.

Features
Internal Halogen lights
Black glass accented control panel
Electric spark ignition (110V/120v)
Analog thermometer
304 Stainless steel tube burners
New sleek hood
Rotisserie kit available

components.name: Echelon E540d Drop-In Grill No Hood
components.description:
This flat top gas grill offers the full performance of a traditional grill with a modern, hoodless design that keeps cooking open and interactive. Perfect for entertaining, it allows you to grill with ease while staying connected with guests. The sleek black glass accent control panel enhances its contemporary style, making it an eye-catching centerpiece in any outdoor kitchen. Combining durability, versatility, and a clean modern look, this grill is ideal for homeowners who want both function and design in their outdoor space.

Features:

Black glass accented control panel
Electric spark ignition (110V/120v)
304 Stainless steel tube burners

components.name: Echelon Black Glass Pizza Oven
components.description:
The handsome, Fire Magic built-in Outdoor Pizza Oven isn’t just for artisan style pizza…you can bake, broil and more. Truly a complete outdoor oven, the Pizza Oven boasts a ceramic glass viewing window in the easy access oven door to the pizza stone or baking rack. This model (#5660) highlights the state-of-the-art black glass control panel featured on Echelon gas grills. Providing digital touchscreen thermostatic operation, this model also boasts integrated smart technology for operation with a smartphone and an internal temperature probe for monitoring cooking temperatures.

Features:
304 Stainless Steel construction
Digital Thermostatic Temperature control (200° – 700°)
Cordierite pizza stone
Baking Rack
IPI Ignition with flame rectification
Oven Door opens flat and can hold up to 50lbs
Ceramic glass door viewing window
Same cut-out dimensions as the E660i grill
Interior light for easy viewing
Optional Portable Cart Grill Base (sold separately) is available if a portable
option is desired. Use part #660-SC24
Optional protective vinyl covers are available for both built-in and
portable versions

components.name: 30" Built In Electric Grill With Single Control

Thermostatic control with touch screen panel or via bluetooth/wifi control from your smart phone

components.name: Hestan 24" Outdoor Undercounter Refrigerator LH -Stealth
components.description:
24" Hestan Outdoor Undercounter Refrigerator (Glass Door) - GRGR Series - GRG_24

The Hestan undercounter refrigerator offers flexible cold storage for ingredients and refreshments. Heavy-duty insulation and forced-air refrigeration system creates optimum storage. Available in a stainless steel door or glass door to fit your outdoor kitchen needs.

- 33°F to 42°F temperature control gives you the flexibility to store cold drinks for your guests or fresh fish for the grill.
- Adjustable, full-extension pullout shelves accommodate everything from platters to bottles.
- Heavy-duty insulation and forced-air refrigeration system creates optimum storage.
- LED interior lighting makes it easy to find what you need.
- Stainless steel front, sides and interior (convertible door design allows for wood overlay)
- Stainless steel or glass front door (low E, UV-coated glass provides industry leading insulation and protection).
- Front-vented, forced-air refrigeration system maintains optimum cold storage.
- 5.2 cubic feet of storage capacity accommodates more than enough burgers to fill the grill.
- Locking doors keep everything secure.
- Adjustable leveling legs and zero clearance hinging.
- UL certified for outdoor use.
- Left- and right-hinged models available.
- Caster kit available.

components.name: 60″ El Dorado Built-In Santa Maria Grill
components.description:
The Ultimate Outdoor Kitchen Live-Fire Cooking Platform
At the heart of the El Dorado’s design is the time-honored tradition of Santa Maria-style grilling, fused with innovative engineering, heavy-duty American craftsmanship, and proudly built in Kansas, USA. The 60″ El Dorado Built-In represents the ultimate expression of this philosophy, creating a live-fire cooking platform capable of grilling, roasting, hanging, ember cooking, and open-fire culinary exploration from a single fire. Designed for custom outdoor kitchens and permanent installations, the 60″ El Dorado Built-In seamlessly integrates the versatility of the El Dorado platform into outdoor living spaces where live-fire cooking is intended to be a central part of the experience.

At the center of the platform is a firebrick-lined cooking floor that serves as the foundation of the entire cooking experience. Designed for exceptional heat retention, efficiency, and fuel flexibility, the refractory-lined floor absorbs, stores, and radiates heat while creating an active cooking surface of its own. Whether utilizing cast iron cookware, Dutch ovens, Plancha’s, griddles, or traditional ember-cooking techniques, the floor itself becomes another layer of cooking capability that extends beyond conventional grilling.

components.name: 42″ El Dorado Built-In Santa Maria Grill
components.description:
The Yoder Smokers El Dorado Built-in will be the centerpiece of your outdoor kitchen. At the heart of the El Dorado’s design is the time-honored tradition of Santa Maria style grilling to create an elevated culinary tool for the backyard or for that professional chef looking for something that stands out from the crowd. The heavy-duty construction and attention to detail creates a set of products that will lead the way in open-fire cooking. The El Dorado series takes traditional function and fuses it with hand-crafted innovation to create a masterful cooking experience to be enjoyed for decades to come.
Whether it’s grilling a steak down low over a scorching hot coal bed or slowly roasting your favorite large cut over an open wood fire with the grate set higher, this is truly the ultimate live-fire experience. The art of open-flame cooking over charcoal or wood providing that flame-kissed flavor, look no further.

components.name: YS640S Built-In Pellet Grill with Insulated Jacket
components.description: The Yoder Smokers YS640S Built-in Pellet Grill is the next product innovation designed in response to those looking to add a Yoder Smokers to that ultimate outdoor kitchen. This built-in design was created with versatility in mind, with three distinct mounting options available to accommodate any layout and provide a seamless mounting process. All three mounting options feature a custom, vented base that not only supports and trims the installed grill, it also helps dissipate trapped heat from the cooking chamber and therefore prolong the service life of the grill. This dissipation of heat also helps protect the counter-top from the intense heat that can be created in those high heat grilling temperatures. In addition, the grill itself has been engineered with a new grease drain threaded into the bottom of the cooking chamber. The new grease drain system features a shutoff valve to keep curious outdoor intruders out of the interior of the grill. Overall, this built-in design is more than meets the eye, combining form and very purposeful function for the perfect outdoor kitchen grilling area.

components.description:
Elevate your outdoor culinary experience with the 28” Drop-in Griddle with Hood. This robust griddle is ready to roll, whether you’re making breakfast, lunch, or dinner. Equipped with cutting-edge features such as ambient puddle lighting, safe start ignition, and three independently controlled heat zones, this griddle is the premier choice. Whether you're building your personalized outdoor kitchen or a BBQ island, this griddle is the ultimate selection for turning your culinary dreams into reality.

It’s safety first with this 28” Insulating Jacket. Designed for the Blackstone 3 Burner Drop-In Griddle, this Insulated Jacket is essential when installing the Drop-In Griddle into a combustible enclosure such as an outdoor kitchen or BBQ Island. Constructed of durable 304 Stainless Steel with a water drainage system and cable utility routing port. This Insulating Jacket requires substructure support. Add a layer of seamless protection to your outdoor kitchen and enjoy the peace of mind it brings.

components.name: 28" Drop-in Griddle w/ hood & insulating jacket (LP)
components.description:
Elevate your outdoor culinary experience with the 28” Drop-in Griddle with Hood. This robust griddle is ready to roll, whether you’re making breakfast, lunch, or dinner. Equipped with cutting-edge features such as ambient puddle lighting, safe start ignition, and three independently controlled heat zones, this griddle is the premier choice. Whether you're building your personalized outdoor kitchen or a BBQ island, this griddle is the ultimate selection for turning your culinary dreams into reality.

It’s safety first with this 28” Insulating Jacket. Designed for the Blackstone 3 Burner Drop-In Griddle, this Insulated Jacket is essential when installing the Drop-In Griddle into a combustible enclosure such as an outdoor kitchen or BBQ Island. Constructed of durable 304 Stainless Steel with a water drainage system and cable utility routing port. This Insulating Jacket requires substructure support. Add a layer of seamless protection to your outdoor kitchen and enjoy the peace of mind it brings.

components.name: 42″ Intelligent-Grill w/ Insulated Jacket -Jet Black
components.description:
The 42″ AIPG magnifies the same elite engineering of its 36″ sibling, offering even more surface area while delivering unmatched performance, innovation, and sophistication—the ultimate statement in luxury outdoor cooking.

Three stainless steel high-performance CoreFlame™ main burners
Thermaglass™ radiant burner shields
2-position integrated Mega-Drive™ rotisserie system with Thermaglass™ IR burner
Signature Taste X2™ integrated smoker system
GraviLift™ grill hood assist
Sensa-Tek™ wireless temperature probe
Intelli-Temp™ smart grilling system
4-zone digital temperature display
Lumatouch™ control lighting
Integrated spit rod storage
987 sq. in. total cooking surface
3-position warming rack stores up and out of the way when rotissing
Triple spot integrated high-intensity halogen work lights
User-friendly push-button ignition with sealed 110V AC power source
Optional variable-heat infrared Sear Zone™ drops into any cooking surface
Available on deluxe cart
Pull-out tank drawer (cart model)
Illuminated drawers and under-storage (cart model)
Standard grill cover included
Available in LP or Natural Gas

components.name: 28" Drop-in Griddle w/ Hood (LP)
components.description:
Features & Specs
Propane Ready configuration
304 grade Stainless steel construction
Flame failure device: if gas is flowing and there’s no flame, the gas will automatically be turned off
3 independently controlled U-shaped burners
Front access rear grease management system
Puddle lighting
Omnivore Griddle Plate Technology
Temperature range of 350 – 650 degrees Fahrenheit
1 year warranty
If any part of the cabinet or structure you have selected for use with your griddle is made from combustible materials (wood, plastic, etc.) your griddle MUST be used with the Blackstone insulating jacket (part number: #6228), available exclusively at http://blackstoneproducts.com. For your safety the insulating jacket must be permanently secured to your cabinet or structure. Please note, even with the use of an insulating jacket, any vertical combustible construction (walls, backsplash, etc.) must be 6 inches away from the appliance.

components.name: 2-Burner BI Unit – Intelligent Series -Signal White
components.description:
An Alfresco side burner is the perfect complement sitting next to your grill for boiling, heating, and simmering anything you need to put into a pot. Built from all commercial stainless steel with heli-arc welded seams, the side burner features two high-performance burners with electronic ignition. The recessed top and stainless steel cover offers protection from wind and elements. The Sear Zone™ side burner is our ceramic infrared searing system in a convenient, self-contained unit.

Restaurant power and control
Dual side burner – all commercial stainless steel with heli-arc welded seams
Two high-performance burners with 110V electronic ignition
Precision knob lighting
Recessed top and stainless steel cover for protection from wind and elements
Available as a built-in unit, or mounts to cart model grills in place of side tray
Available in LP or Natural Gas

components.name: Small Big Green Egg
components.description:
The Small Big Green Egg combines versatility and precision in a compact design. This compact powerhouse delivers the same unparalleled versatility and temperature control as its larger counterparts, all within a 13-inch (33 cm) diameter. Grill, smoke, roast, and bake with ease, achieving restaurant-quality results in your own backyard. At 80 pounds (36 kg), this robust cooker combines portability with durability, featuring the same high-quality ceramics and innovative airflow system that have made the egg a favorite among culinary enthusiasts. Its precise temperature control, ranging from low-and-slow to searing heat, allows you to explore a world of flavors and techniques.

Enhance your cooking experience with carefully designed accessories like the convEGGtor for indirect cooking, or the EGG Genius for remote temperature monitoring. Premium hardwood charcoal ignites quickly and imparts a clean, subtle smokiness that elevates your dishes without overpowering them.

components.description:

components.description:

This icemaker is sized at just 32" high to fit under lower ADA compliant counters. The legs can be raised to 34 1/4" for taller spaces. The distinct dense structure helps minimize dilution, keeping drinks colder for longer without watering them down. The uniform shape offers an elegant presentation, while its non-clumping design ensures easy dispensing. The size can be adjusted between three settings to best suit your taste. We include a steel ice scoop that can be hung inside for easy serving. 

This icemaker features easy-to-use digital controls. An indicator light alerts users to each step in the production process and when the bin is full. Frost-free operation eliminates the need to defrost the interior. Additional features include a temperature memory function, cleaning setting and alarm, and sabbath mode for periods of observances.

components.description:
The new and innovative Memphis Elevate™ built-in pellet grill is like nothing else on the market!

Equipped with a stunning, modular design and our industry-exclusive Direct Flame Technology, the Memphis Elevate is a breakthrough in traditional pellet grill style. Its game-changing design and superior wood fire cooking capabilities take grilling to new heights in a versatile configuration that allows you to purchase the grill head separately and add on accessory packages to utilize as a built-in or a freestanding cart.

The Built-in Bracket Accessory package (pictured here) provides vented brackets that connect to the sides and back of the grill head to give it a finished look once placed into an outdoor kitchen as a built-in grill. Includes four mounting brackets and all the hardware needed to attach the brackets to the grill head and convert to a built-in pellet grill.

View the Memphis Elevate Freestanding Pellet Grill.

Like our other flagship Memphis grills, the Memphis Elevate Built-In boasts the ability to smoke, braise, grill, roast, bake and sear on one outdoor cooking appliance that rivals a high-end indoor kitchen!

180 – 600 degrees for smoking, searing, and everything in between!
Two open flame modes designed into the controller and reaching up to 900+ degrees

Convenient front tool bar
Meat probe features three convenient ports and precise internal temp monitoring

Some assembly and/or attachment required (built-in brackets)
Wi-Fi provides monitoring, alerts and timer
*Memphis Wood Fire Grills will work with customers via our technical services team to determine any potential issues with Wi-Fi connection of their grill.  It is our goal to provide the best possible experience and convenience with our grills.   With that in mind, there are a wide range of router systems available to consumers today with various levels of internet signal strength and we cannot guarantee that the Wi-Fi system built with our grills will work in every situation. 

Although we will work with you to get your system connected, the true value of our grills is the amazing cooking experience it provides.  With the ability to smoke, roast, grill, braise, bake and sear at temperatures well above 900 degrees with multiple levels of our Direct Flame technology, there is nothing you can’t cook to perfection.  We sincerely hope you enjoy the flexibility and simplicity of using your Memphis Wood Fire Grill.

components.name: 21 Inch Kamado KoKoMo Ceramic BBQ Grill
components.description:
Introducing the KoKoMo KoKoMaDo Kamado Grills:

Enhance Your Charcoal Cooking Experience.

Experience the pinnacle of charcoal cooking with our exceptional line of KoKoMo KoKoMaDo Kamado Grills. These grills are designed to offer unparalleled versatility, allowing you to grill, smoke, bake pizzas, bread, pies, and cookies with effortless ease. Thanks to their exceptional heat retention properties, you have precise control over achieving and maintaining high temperatures through the top and bottom vents. Whether you're searing succulent burgers or slow-cooking larger cuts, the KoKoMo KoKoMaDo Kamado is your ultimate culinary companion.

 

Key Features:

Versatility Redefined: A true all-in-one marvel, the KoKoMo KoKoMaDo Kamado serves as a BBQ, grill, smoker, and oven, providing limitless culinary possibilities.

Optimal Heat Circulation: The unique design and premium-grade insulating ceramic material ensure superior heat retention and even heat distribution, resulting in juicy, perfectly cooked food with minimal fuel consumption.

 

Specifications:

Cooking Grill Diameter: 21” Classic, perfect for family gatherings.

Stainless Steel Grill with Hinged Section: Effortlessly add fuel or smoking chips without disturbing your cooking.

Temperature Range: Achieve temperatures up to 450°C, then easily adjust to your desired cooking temperature.

Durable Ceramic Shell: Boasts a glazed exterior finish for longevity, exceptional temperature retention, and effortless cleaning.

Convenience with Folding Side Shelves: Easily store condiments and beverages, then fold away for compact storage.

Precise Temperature Control: Fully adjustable top and bottom dampers for exacting control over cooking temperatures.

Built-in Thermometer: Featuring a large bezel for easy, accurate temperature monitoring.

Heavy Duty Hinge: A spring-loaded hinge for smooth lid operation.

Fireproof Felt Seals: Ensuring total insulation and extended lifespan.

 

Included Accessories:

Stainless Steel Stand with 4 Wheels (2 lockable) for stability and ease of placement.

Stainless Steel Cooking Grid.

Comprehensive User Manual: Includes cooking temperature guide, setup instructions, as well as maintenance and preparation tips.

 

Weight and Dimensions:

Outer Diameter: 21.5 inches
Cooking Grid Diameter: 18.4 inches (46.7 cm)
Cooking Area: 265.7 square inches
Assembled Dimensions (LDH): 51.2 inches x 28.7 inches x 48 inches (130 cm x 73 cm x 122 cm)
Operation Height: 35.8 inches (91 cm)
Net Weight/Gross Weight: 183 lbs (69.5 kg / 83 kg)

components.name: 42" Aspire by Hestan BI Grill with Rotisserie (Mixed Burners) -Stealth
components.description:
304 STAINLESS STEEL BURNER
Heavy-duty 304 stainless steel tubular burners deliver 23,000 BTUs each of consistent heat and years of reliability.

• Spring-assisted hood opens easily.
• Built-in ceramic infrared rotisserie burner from 12,000 to 18,000 Btu/hour (depending on model) with simple touch on function.
• Available high-performance variable ceramic infrared sear burner delivers an additional 23,000 BTUs of searing heat to lock in flavor.
• Patent-pending symmetrical flip-to-clean radiant tray generates sizzling flavor with ceramic disc briquettes.
• 774-square-inch primary grilling surface with 219-square-inch warming rack surface makes room for large cookouts.
• External rotisserie motor with a single-speed, 3 rpm, 40 in-lbs motor.
• Porcelain broiling pan with stainless steel rotisserie spit and forks.
• Patented Marquise Accented™ control panel and hood handle with commercial-grade end caps provide industry-exclusive durability and style.
/
DUAL HALOGEN LIGHTING
Two 20-watt halogen bulbs light up the grill interior so you can keep an eye on every corner of the grill.

• Hot surface ignition system.
• 304 stainless steel heavy-gauge, welded body construction.
• LED front control panel lighting with simple touch-on function.
• Patented monogrammed temperature gauge with cooking zone markings.
• Stainless steel removable drip tray for easy maintenance and cleanup.
• Patented stainless steel rod grates.
• Lifetime warranty on welded body, stainless tubular burners and variable sear burners.
/
ZAMAK DIE-CAST KNOBS
and LED-illuminated control panel offer easy control.

components.name: 36″ Aspire by Hestan BI Grill with Rotisserie (Mixed Burners) -Stealth
components.description:
304 STAINLESS STEEL BURNER
Heavy-duty 304 stainless steel tubular burners deliver 23,000 BTUs each of consistent heat and years of reliability.

• Spring-assisted hood opens easily.
• Built-in ceramic infrared rotisserie burner from 12,000 to 18,000 Btu/hour (depending on model) with simple touch on function.
• Available high-performance variable ceramic infrared sear burner delivers an additional 23,000 BTUs of searing heat to lock in flavor.
• Patent-pending symmetrical flip-to-clean radiant tray generates sizzling flavor with ceramic disc briquettes.
• 647-square-inch primary grilling surface with 183-square-inch warming rack surface makes room for large cookouts.
• External rotisserie motor with a single-speed, 3 rpm, 40 in-lbs motor.
• Porcelain broiling pan with stainless steel rotisserie spit and forks.
• Patented Marquise Accented™ control panel and hood handle with commercial-grade end caps provide industry-exclusive durability and style.
/
DUAL HALOGEN LIGHTING
Two 20-watt halogen bulbs light up the grill interior so you can keep an eye on every corner of the grill.

• Hot surface ignition system.
• 304 stainless steel heavy-gauge, welded body construction.
• LED front control panel lighting with simple touch-on function.
• Patented monogrammed temperature gauge with cooking zone markings.
• Stainless steel removable drip tray for easy maintenance and cleanup.
• Patented stainless steel rod grates.
• Lifetime warranty on welded body, stainless tubular burners and variable sear burners.
/
ZAMAK DIE-CAST KNOBS
and LED-illuminated control panel offer easy control.

components.name: 30" Aspire by Hestan BI Grill (Mixed Burners) -Stealth
components.description:
304 STAINLESS STEEL BURNER
Heavy-duty 304 stainless steel tubular burners deliver 23,000 BTUs each of consistent heat and years of reliability.

• Spring-assisted hood opens easily.
• Built-in ceramic infrared rotisserie burner from 12,000 to 18,000 Btu/hour (depending on model) with simple touch on function.
• Available high-performance variable ceramic infrared sear burner delivers an additional 23,000 BTUs of searing heat to lock in flavor.
• Patent-pending symmetrical flip-to-clean radiant tray generates sizzling flavor with ceramic disc briquettes.
• 519-square-inch primary grilling surface with 147-square-inch warming rack surface makes room for large cookouts.
• External rotisserie motor with a single-speed, 3 rpm, 40 in-lbs motor.
• Porcelain broiling pan with stainless steel rotisserie spit and forks.
• Patented Marquise Accented™ control panel and hood handle with commercial-grade end caps provide industry-exclusive durability and style.
/
DUAL HALOGEN LIGHTING
Two 20-watt halogen bulbs light up the grill interior so you can keep an eye on every corner of the grill.

• Hot surface ignition system.
• 304 stainless steel heavy-gauge, welded body construction.
• LED front control panel lighting with simple touch-on function.
• Patented monogrammed temperature gauge with cooking zone markings.
• Stainless steel removable drip tray for easy maintenance and cleanup.
• Patented stainless steel rod grates.
• Lifetime warranty on welded body, stainless tubular burners and variable sear burners.
/
ZAMAK DIE-CAST KNOBS
and LED-illuminated control panel offer easy control.

components.name: Arc Lite
components.description:
Arc Lite delivers chef-level performance and award-winning design in a compact, lightweight form made for any space, from balconies to backyards and rooftop gatherings. Unmistakably Gozney, it captures the power, control, and beauty of our flagship pizza ovens, reimagined for effortless everyday cooking.

From unboxing to first fire in minutes, Arc Lite hits 500°C through its signature lateral flame for perfectly cooked 12-inch pizza and flame-finished dishes.

Engineered for lasting performance, Arc Lite redefines what compact live fire can do, transforming every cook into an experience worth sharing.

Oven external dimensions: W 430mm (16.9”) x D 481mm (18.9”) x H 297mm (11.7”)
Oven internal dimensions: W 325mm (12.8”) x D 355mm (14.0”) x H 150mm (5.9”)
Oven mouth dimensions: W 325mm (12.8”) x H 85mm (3.35”)

components.name: Hestan 24" Outdoor Double Faucet Beer Dispenser RH -BoraBora
components.description:
24" Hestan Outdoor Single Faucet Beer Dispenser – GFDS Series - GFDS_241

The Hestan beer dispenser keeps your favorite libation fresh and perfectly frosty with temperature control from 33ºF to 42ºF. Heavy-duty insulation and forced-air refrigeration system creates optimum storage.

- Precision temperature control with digital display keeps your favorite beverage at your favorite temperature from 33ºF to 42ºF.
- Heavy-duty insulation and forced-air refrigeration system creates optimum storage.
- LED interior lighting helps you find exactly what you’re looking for.
- 5.2 cubic feet storage capacity accommodates one 1/4 barrel (pony keg) or two 1/6 barrels (5 gallon).
- Stainless steel front, sides and interior (convertible door design allows for wood overlay).
- Locking doors keep everything secure.
- Adjustable leveling legs and zero clearance hinging.
- UL certified for outdoor use.
- Left- and right-hinged models available.
- Caster kit available.

components.name: Hestan 42" Outdoor BI Grill (Mixed Burners) -Stealth
components.description:
FEATURES
Patented heavy-duty Horizon Hood™ opens easily with spring-assisted hinges and holds place at desired height for easy access.
Patented Halogen Stadium Lights™ illuminate the entire cooking area with motion-activated under-hood lighting.
Patented ceramic infrared top burner delivers 12,000 to 18,000 BTUs – perfect for searing/finishing and cooking with the included rotisserie.
Patented Trellis Burner™ design delivers 25,000 BTUs of high-performance power with greater heat coverage and precision control.
Patented DiamondCut™ grates create a superior grilling surface and greater heat distribution with ultra heavy-duty 5/16″ stainless steel (lasered in-house).
Split-shelf warming rack (42" model only) features an upper shelf position for browning and melting under the infrared rotisserie burner, and a lower shelf position for keeping food warm.
High-performance variable ceramic infrared sear burners offer 25,000 BTUs each.
774-square-inch primary grilling surface with 282-square-inch warming rack surface makes room for large cookouts.
Patented flip-to-clean radiant tray with monogrammed ceramic briquettes generates smoky flavor from drippings.
Concealed whisper-quiet rotisserie motor system features a chain-driven, single-speed, 6 rpm, 50 in-lbs motor.
Patented Marquise Accented™ control panel and hood handle with commercial-grade end caps.
Patented stainless steel DiamondCut™ warming rack is lasered in-house with three vertical positions and offers concealed storage when not in use.
One-push automatic ignition system fires up grill with a single click.
LED front control panel lighting makes controls easy to operate even at night.
Available in Natural Gas (NG) or Liquid Propane (LP).
Carbon fiber vinyl cover available.
High altitude kit available.
Trellis Burner™ conversion kit available.
Gas conversion kits (NG/LP) available.
Variable sear conversion kit available.

components.name: Hestan 24" Outdoor Dual Zone Refrigerator with Wine Storage RH - Stealth
components.description:
24" Hestan Outdoor Dual Zone Refrigerator w/Wine Storage (Solid Door) – GRWS Series - GRS_24

The dual zone refrigerator offers two independent temperature zones so you can store both reds and whites at optimum temperature. Full-extension wine racks keep your wines safe from vibration while the stainless steel door keeps out harmful sunlight.

- Two temperature zones with precision control create the perfect environment for your wines – from 33°F to 42°F in the bottom zone and 45°F to 65°F in the top zone.

components.name: Hestan 24" Outdoor Refrigerator Drawer and Freezer Drawer RH -Steeletto
components.description:
24" Hestan Outdoor Refrigerator Drawer and Freezer Drawer – GRF Series - GRFR24

Refrigerator drawer and freezer drawer offers convenient cold storage for food or beverages and preserves meats or frozen treats. Heavy-duty insulation and forced-air refrigeration system creates optimum storage, while LED interior lighting and full-extension drawer slides make it easy to find what you need.

- 33°F to 42°F temperature control gives you the flexibility to store cold drinks for your guests or fresh fish for the grill.
- Lower freezer drawer preserves meats or frozen treats with temperature control from -10ºF to 10ºF.
- Heavy-duty insulation maintains the perfect cold storage environment.
- LED interior lighting and full-extension drawer slides make it easy to find what you need.
- Stainless steel front, sides and interior (convertible door design allows for wood overlay).
- Front-vented, forced-air refrigeration system maintains optimum cold storage.
- 5.2 cubic feet of storage capacity accommodates more than enough burgers to fill the grill.
- Locking drawers keeps everything secure.
- Adjustable leveling legs.
- UL certified for outdoor use.
- Caster kit available.

24" Hestan Outdoor Undercounter Refrigerator (Solid Door) – GRSR Series - GRS_24

The Hestan undercounter refrigerator offers flexible cold storage for ingredients and refreshments. Heavy-duty insulation and forced-air refrigeration system creates optimum storage. Available in a stainless steel door or glass door to fit your outdoor kitchen needs.

- 33°F to 42°F temperature control gives you the flexibility to store cold drinks for your guests or fresh fish for the grill.
- Adjustable, full-extension pullout shelves accommodate everything from platters to bottles.
- Heavy-duty insulation and forced-air refrigeration system creates optimum storage.
- LED interior lighting makes it easy to find what you need.
- Stainless steel front, sides and interior (convertible door design allows for wood overlay)
- Stainless steel or glass front door (low E, UV-coated glass provides industry leading insulation and protection).
- Front-vented, forced-air refrigeration system maintains optimum cold storage.
- 5.2 cubic feet of storage capacity accommodates more than enough burgers to fill the grill.
- Locking doors keep everything secure.
- Adjustable leveling legs and zero clearance hinging.
- UL certified for outdoor use.
- Left- and right-hinged models available.
- Caster kit available.

components.name: 16'' Countertop Pizza Oven
Blackstone Pizza Oven
components.description: Power, performance, and elegance are all packed into the Select Pizza Oven. With patented 2Stone® Technology, the top stone radiates even heat to the top of the pizza while the bottom stone rotates giving you an even cook and a streamlined cooking experience. Feel like a pro with the included perforated pizza peel easily stored in the built-in holster. The oven is equipped with a propane storage cabinet that features soft-closed door hinges keeping the door closed in windy conditions. Fall in love with the art of creating pizzas and anything else you can imagine with the Select Pizza Oven.

components.name: Hestan 36" Outdoor BI Grill (Mixed Burners) -Stealth
components.description:
FEATURES
Patented heavy-duty Horizon Hood™ opens easily with spring-assisted hinges and holds place at desired height for easy access.
Patented Halogen Stadium Lights™ illuminate the entire cooking area with motion-activated under-hood lighting.
Patented ceramic infrared top burner delivers 12,000 to 18,000 BTUs – perfect for searing/finishing and cooking with the included rotisserie.
Patented Trellis Burner™ design delivers 25,000 BTUs of high-performance power with greater heat coverage and precision control.
Patented DiamondCut™ grates create a superior grilling surface and greater heat distribution with ultra heavy-duty 5/16″ stainless steel (lasered in-house).
High-performance variable ceramic infrared sear burners offer 25,000 BTUs each.
647-square-inch primary grilling surface with 236-square-inch warming rack surface makes room for large cookouts.
Patented flip-to-clean radiant tray with monogrammed ceramic briquettes generates smoky flavor from drippings.
Concealed whisper-quiet rotisserie motor system features a chain-driven, single-speed, 6 rpm, 50 in-lbs motor.
Patented Marquise Accented™ control panel and hood handle with commercial-grade end caps.
Patented stainless steel DiamondCut™ warming rack is lasered in-house with three vertical positions and offers concealed storage when not in use.
One-push automatic ignition system fires up grill with a single click.
LED front control panel lighting makes controls easy to operate even at night.
Available in Natural Gas (NG) or Liquid Propane (LP).
Carbon fiber vinyl cover available.
High altitude kit available.
Trellis Burner™ conversion kit available.
Gas conversion kits (NG/LP) available.
Variable sear conversion kit available.

Patented heavy-duty Horizon Hood™ opens easily with spring-assisted hinges and holds place at desired height for easy access.
Patented Halogen Stadium Lights™ illuminate the entire cooking area with motion-activated under-hood lighting.
Patented ceramic infrared top burner delivers 12,000 to 18,000 BTUs – perfect for searing/finishing and cooking with the included rotisserie.
Patented Trellis Burner™ design delivers 25,000 BTUs of high-performance power with greater heat coverage and precision control.
Patented DiamondCut™ grates create a superior grilling surface and greater heat distribution with ultra heavy-duty 5/16″ stainless steel (lasered in-house).
High-performance variable ceramic infrared sear burners offer 25,000 BTUs each.
647-square-inch primary grilling surface with 236-square-inch warming rack surface makes room for large cookouts.
Patented flip-to-clean radiant tray with monogrammed ceramic briquettes generates smoky flavor from drippings.
Concealed whisper-quiet rotisserie motor system features a chain-driven, single-speed, 6 rpm, 50 in-lbs motor.
Patented Marquise Accented™ control panel and hood handle with commercial-grade end caps.
Patented stainless steel DiamondCut™ warming rack is lasered in-house with three vertical positions and offers concealed storage when not in use.
One-push automatic ignition system fires up grill with a single click.
LED front control panel lighting makes controls easy to operate even at night.
Available in Natural Gas (NG) or Liquid Propane (LP).
Carbon fiber vinyl cover available.
High altitude kit available.
Trellis Burner™ conversion kit available.
Gas conversion kits (NG/LP) available.
Variable sear conversion kit available.

LED control panel lights
304 stainless steel construction

Solid 5/16 stainless steel griddle surface
Easy to clean, removable trough
Stainless steel top cover
9V electronic ignition
Made in USA

components.name: Blaze LTE PRO Power Burner w/ Insulated Jacket
components.description:
The Blaze LTE PRO Power Burner features independently controlled inner and outer burner rings made from cast 304 stainless steel, allowing you to tailor heat output to a wide range of cooking needs. The inner burner delivers 25,000 BTUs for low, controlled heat, while the outer burner produces 35,000 BTUs for high-heat cooking—combining for a total of 60,000 BTUs of power.

This flexible dual-ring design makes it easy to simmer sauces, boil large pots, or fry at high heat using one or both burners at once. The heavy-duty stainless steel cooking grid includes a removable center ring for wok cooking, adding even more versatility.

LED backlit control knobs with safety glow illumination provide clear gas-on indication and match the LTE PRO line of grills and griddles, offering improved visibility and a cohesive look across your outdoor kitchen.
High-efficiency design delivers faster boil times than comparable power burners
Cast stainless steel dual-ring burner with independent controls for flexible heat management
LED-illuminated control knobs provide clear gas-on indication and match Blaze LTE PRO grills and griddles
Slim design maximizes space for additional components or counter area
Integrated wok ring supports authentic wok-style cooking over high heat

components.name: 28" Drop-in Griddle w/ hood & insulating jacket (NG)
components.description:
Elevate your outdoor culinary experience with the 28” Drop-in Griddle with Hood. This robust griddle is ready to roll, whether you’re making breakfast, lunch, or dinner. Equipped with cutting-edge features such as ambient puddle lighting, safe start ignition, and three independently controlled heat zones, this griddle is the premier choice. Whether you're building your personalized outdoor kitchen or a BBQ island, this griddle is the ultimate selection for turning your culinary dreams into reality.

It’s safety first with this 28” Insulating Jacket. Designed for the Blackstone 3 Burner Drop-In Griddle, this Insulated Jacket is essential when installing the Drop-In Griddle into a combustible enclosure such as an outdoor kitchen or BBQ Island. Constructed of durable 304 Stainless Steel with a water drainage system and cable utility routing port. This Insulating Jacket requires substructure support. Add a layer of seamless protection to your outdoor kitchen and enjoy the peace of mind it brings.

Please note, even with the use of an insulating jacket, any vertical combustible construction (walls, backsplash, etc.) must be 6 inches away from the appliance.

Built with thick, heat-retaining ceramic construction, this 24-inch kamado grill delivers exceptional temperature stability for both low-and-slow smoking and high-heat searing up to 600°F+. Whether you’re searching for a ceramic charcoal grill, kamado smoker grill, or a versatile outdoor charcoal grill for backyard kitchens, the Blackhorn is engineered to handle it all with precision airflow control and superior fuel efficiency.

This versatile kamado grill functions as a charcoal grill, smoker, pizza oven, roaster, and ceramic BBQ grill in one powerful system. The included Axis™ Adjustable Multi-Level Cooking System allows for direct and indirect cooking at the same time, while the ceramic pizza stone doubles as a heat deflector plate for authentic wood-fired style cooking. From brisket and ribs to steakhouse-quality searing and artisan pizza, this kamado smoker grill locks in moisture and enhances flavor with every cook.

Designed for durability and convenience, the Blackhorn features an easy lift-out ash clean-out bucket, completes the outdoor kitchen, and is for backyard chefs who demand versatility, efficiency, and premium results.

Intuitive Controls for Precision Cooking

Stylish and Functional Design

With its sleek and modern design, the KoKoMo Teppanyaki Griddle adds an element of sophistication to your outdoor kitchen. The stainless steel finish not only exudes a timeless elegance but is also easy to clean and maintain.

 

Perfect for Entertaining

Whether you're hosting a weekend brunch, preparing a feast for a family gathering, or simply enjoying a casual weeknight meal, this griddle provides a versatile and dynamic cooking platform that will impress your guests.

components.name: Kokomo 32" Elite Built-In Gas Grill (4 Burner)
components.description:
All Kokomo Grills

Build and design your own Outdoor Kitchen with the most versatile outdoor cooking appliances on the market. ALL KOKOMO APPLIANCES include a Lifetime Warranty, and are completely constructed out of 304 Stainless Steel. 304 stainless steel is used around the world due to excellent corrosion resistance. 304 stainless can also withstand corrosion from most oxidizing acids. That durability makes 304 easy to sanitize, and therefore ideal for an outdoor kitchen. Take a close look at the small details that separates us from our competitors. Experience makes a big difference, for over 25 years, we have been taking each and every idea into consideration, and we are constantly making improvements. If you're wanting a long lasting product, with REAL superior features, this is the brand for you.

 

All Kokomo Grill hoods have dual wall construction, which means that the stainless steel will never fade or lose its color, making it look brand new years down the road. We engineered this grill with a more squared-off hood to give it a more “dominant” look.

 

On the inside of the grill, we supplied commercial-grade, non-coated cooking grids. The stainless steel makes it easy to clean, and provides more heat control than other grill surfaces.. We also found that our cooking grids are a lot tighter, and heavier than similar brands. All Kokomo Grills are also supplied with a warming rack. Behind the warming rack, is a powerful IR backburner that gets up to 1000 degrees in under 30 seconds!

 

Underneath the cooking grids, we use a commercial grade stainless steel flame tamer system. This ensures even heating throughout the entire surface of the grill, and they do an amazing job at distributing the heat… They are very easy to clean, and they prevent flare ups. 

 

Below the stainless steel flame tamer system we provide upgraded CAST stainless steel burners, which push a high amount of 15,000 BTUs. Stainless steel casting is widely used across many industries due to it's high strength and it's resistance to corrosion.

 

We also added a reliable blow torch ignition system, called “SureLight Ignition” which makes it easy to fire your grill up on the first click. Every single knob has its own individual system, which means you have multiple backup igniters. 

 

This grill can be added to a cart, or be built in for a DIY project. We designed the grill to have a 1” Flange all the way around to hide your cutout for a clean drop in. 

 

Available in Liquid Propane or Natural Gas

components.name: Aurora Power Burner w/ Porcelain Cast Iron Grid & Insulating Liner

The Aurora Power Burner is the largest, most powerful side cooker available and provides the high heat that’s perfect for wok cooking or frying a turkey!

components.description:
All-in-one outdoor oven designed for baking, roasting, searing, and rotisserie cooking

components.description:
Powerful performance, sleek design, & enhanced safety features for exceptional grilling
Innovative safety valves & thermocouple design so you can grill with peace of mind
Rear burner & interchangeable sear burner for flexible cooking options
Color-shifting LED knobs indicate temperature changes from low to high
Throw light beams the Coyote logo onto the ground for a premium touch

The Coyote SL-Series 36 inch built-in propane grill offers innovative safety features & top of the line performance. Built from premium 304 stainless steel, this grill is packed with premium features including a spring-assisted hood, interactive lighting, & warming rack. The Coyote logo throw light not only makes a statement but illuminates your grilling area for the ultimate nighttime grilling experience. The double walled hood provides excellent insulation, helping to retain heat more effectively. The integrated wind guard ensures consistent heat and performance, so you can keep grilling even in windy conditions. The newly updated design also includes sleek knob and bezel styling, an improved end cap, and a sturdy handle for a refined look. Unique volcanic stone briquettes work in tandem with the four powerful Infinity burners to provide excellent heat retention & consistent heat across the laser-cut grates. The interchangeable sear burner, rear burner, & rotisserie kit offer additional versatility, giving you the flexibility to create a variety of dishes. Designed for optimal safety & reliability, the innovative safety valve & thermocouple system allows gas to flow only when a flame is present. If the flame goes out, the thermocouple automatically shuts off the gas, preventing any potential hazards. Grill with peace of mind and enjoy outdoor cooking in your backyard for years to come.

The double inch side burner reaches up to 24,000 BTUs between both burners. If installing the 12-inch double side burner into combustible material, you must first install an insulated sleeve.

If installing the 16-inch power side burner into combustible material, you must first install an insulated sleeve.

Introducing the Blaze Builder Classic Model (BCM)—a no-nonsense gas grill designed for dependable, commercial-style performance at an approachable price. Built from durable 304-grade stainless steel, the BCM is engineered for long-lasting use in backyards, shared spaces, and multifamily environments. components.name: 36" Outdoor Built-In Induction Griddle
components.description:
The 36″ Outdoor Induction Griddle from Induction Hardware is the world’s first induction-electric BBQ griddle — engineered to deliver professional-grade performance outdoors without flame, gas, or compromise. Designed for modern outdoor kitchens, balconies, and fire-restricted environments, it redefines what’s possible beyond traditional grills.

Built around four oversized square induction coils, this griddle offers single-zone, dual-zone, and bridge functionality for exceptionally even heating and full-surface power. Whether you’re searing steaks, cooking breakfast for a crowd, or simmering sauces alongside high-heat grilling, induction delivers instant response, precise control, and unmatched energy efficiency.

The removable 8mm carbon steel griddle is a first of its kind — completely free of PFAS and toxic coatings, naturally non-stick when seasoned, and designed for serious heat retention. Remove the griddle entirely to unlock a full outdoor cooking surface capable of supporting oversized pots and pans, from seafood boils to outdoor pasta nights.

Crafted from solid, outdoor-certified 304 stainless steel, the 36″ Outdoor Induction Griddle is built to withstand the elements while maintaining a clean, architectural presence. Flameless operation eliminates fire risk, removes the need for propane tanks, and makes it safe for balconies and areas where traditional gas grills are prohibited.

components.name: Roccbox - Black
components.description: A scaled down and portable version of our commercial pizza ovens, Roccbox is the original stone-floor portable oven that started a pizza revolution. Simply, Roccbox is the world’s highest performing portable pizza oven. It reaches 950°F and stays hot, so you can cook pizza after pizza in under sixty seconds, wherever you go. Add in intuitive features like the retractable legs, detachable burner, and low-profile design and you’re ready to hit the road at a moment's notice. Portable - Take Roccbox anywhere with its retractable legs, detachable burner and built-in thermometer. Reaches 950°F - Enjoy unrivalled cooking results created by a thick stone floor, dense insulation and a unique rolling flame. Gas or wood fueled - Roccbox comes with a propane gas burner as standard, and the option to buy a detachable wood burner if you choose dual fuel. Safe touch - Host pizza parties with the family friendly option. Roccbox’s safe-touch silicone jacket reduces the risk of skin burns that can often occur with metal bodied ovens. Restaurant-grade - Engineered to replicate the performance of Gozney’s professional ovens, used by leading chefs and restaurants all over the world.

Plus, Arc’s intuitive flame control makes it easy to create restaurant-quality 14” pizza in 60s or less, making it the go-to for our world-famous Pizza Collective. With Arc you can create epic pizza, in your perfect outdoor cooking space, easier than ever before. components.name: Dome (Gen 2) - Off Black
components.description: Dome (Gen 2) is a new era of cooking with fire. Our most versatile oven yet—over 40% bigger than the original Dome. With space to cook two pizzas at once, it’s built for far more than pizza and designed to handle full meals for family and friends. Every element has been re-engineered to give you total control: over heat, over fuel, over fire itself. At its core is restaurant-grade performance—used by the world’s best chefs, made effortless for home cooks. Cook with wood for smoky intensity, gas for clean heat, or charcoal for earthy depth. All powered by a suite of next-generation features and purpose-built accessories that make live-fire cooking feel effortless. From the optional Wood-Fire Control Kit, which gives you the power to control wood like gas, to an intuitive digital interface that displays real-time air and stone temperature, with twin meat probes that track two cuts independently—so you know exactly when your food is perfectly cooked. Dome (Gen 2) arrives fully assembled and ready to go, straight out of the box. components.name: 24" wide single drawer bulit-in all-refrigerator for indoor or outdoor use with panel-ready front
components.description:
Summit manufactures an extensive selection of built-in refrigeration specially constructed for safe and reliable cooling in outdoor kitchens. 

The SDR241OS is a single drawer all-refrigerator that meets NSF-7 and UL-471 commercial standards and is also approved for residential settings. It's sized at just under 24" wide for an easy fit in standard cutouts, with a front-breathing design that allows built-in installation. The weatherproof construction allows safe use in outdoor settings, with a sealed back and fully finished black cabinet to ensure all components are protected from the elements. The drawer is constructed from 304 grade stainless steel, with a pro style handle and fully finished front. For more custom style, the drawer is panel-ready, allowing you to match or complement existing cabinetry in a few simple steps (panel dimensions: 15.6" H x 23.4" W at 3/4" maximum thickness).

Frost-free operation with fan-forced cooling ensures even temperature distribution with minimal user maintenance. A digital thermostat, located atop the refrigerator drawer, makes it easy to manage the temperature, with an LED display that can be read in Celsius or Fahrenheit. We include a removable clear cover that helps protect all components from the elements. To adjust the settings, slide the off to access the screen. 

Inside, the SDR241OS offers a full 2 cu.ft. capacity to accommodate your storage needs. Two removable dividers let you separate the drawer into one, two, or three zones to accommodate a variety of sizes. We also include a half-sized glass shelf. LED lighting affords a convenient view of store contents, while a child lock will disable the digital controls after two minutes of inactivity to prevent accidental adjustments. Additional features include audible alarms for high-temperature fluctuations and open drawer alerts, while a temporary memory function helps to recover all settings in the event of power loss. The Sabbath Mode setting disables certain electrical features during periods of religious observance.

With its fully-featured, weatherproof design, the SDR241OS is the perfect cooling compartment or beverage holder in outdoor or indoor home kitchens, as well as hotel spaces, foodservice areas, and more.

Note: Wood panel is not included. The images provided are meant only to be suggestive of what the product with a wood panel installed could look like. Users must supply their own wood panel.

The ADRF244OS is ETL-S listed to NSF-7 commercial standards and approved for residential use. components.name: Built-In 700 Series 44" Built-In Gas Grill w/ insulated jacket
components.description:
The Stainless Steel 700 Series 44-inch Natural Gas Grill features 108,000 BTU's 6 Stainless Steel Main Burners, Dual infrared Rear Rotisserie Burner, and a generous cooking area of 41.5-inches x 18-inches (105.41 cm x 45.72 cm)
The 0.354-inch (9.5 mm) thick stainless steel cooking grids are virtually maintenance free and the unique wave shape provides even heating, prevents food from falling through, and produces exceptional sear marks
Ignite the 700 Series 44-inch Built-In Gas Barbecue Grill instantly with the battery free ignition. This failsafe ignition system lights burners immediately with a jet of flame
Keep your barbecue cleaner for longer, the dual level stainless steel sear plates protect your burners while directing any drippings to the perforated, angular grease management plates. These combined ensure that any grease that isn't vaporized is collected, reducing buildup and risk of grease fires significantly
The BIG44 44-inch Built-In Gas Barbecue Grill features an infrared rear burner and comes with a commercial grade rotisserie kit for perfect spit roasted meals
Safely and easily store the rotisserie kit inside the integrated rotisserie storage under the barbecue
The ergonomic control knobs are backlit to provide ambiance and safety, glowing a glorious blue that changes to red when the burners are in use. Add to that the interior halogen lights to illuminate your grilling surface for nighttime grilling that is an absolute joy
The Built-In 700 Series 44-inch Gas Grill has been designed specifically for ease of installation with integrated trim and longer electrical wiring, and an extra long flex line, increasing functionality and reducing design restrictions. Planning and installation are even easier with a 2-inch (5.08 cm) tolerance for cut-outs
Precise temperature control and the ACCU-PROBE™ temperature gauge ensure that you're searing, smoking, roasting, rotisserizing, and baking with ease

components.description:
Summit brings energy efficiency to the outdoors with the SPR196OS, an ENERGY STAR certified all-refrigerator approved for outdoor use. 

The SPR196OS features a versatile design that meets NSF-7 and UL-471 commercial standards but is also approved for residential use. Sized at just 19 inches wide and 17.25 inches deep, it features a jet black cabinet with a sealed back for safe installation outdoors and protection from the elements. The user-reversible stainless steel door adds durability and elegance to any outdoor setting and the stainless steel pro-style handle completes the look. A factory-installed lock keeps contents secure, while a right-angle plug and integrated hinge provide added flexibility in placing the unit. Two leveling legs keep the unit level on uneven surfaces. 

Inside, the SPR196OS utilizes an internal fan to ensure the unit is evenly cooled from top to bottom. An automatic defrost system ensures minimal user maintenance, while LED lighting allows full visibility of stored items in the jet black interior. Three adjustable slide-out glass shelves with six placement positions provide flexible storage capacity inside the 3.1 cu. ft. interior. A shelving brake system offers added safety when moving and storing contents, while two chrome door racks are ideal for storing condiments, canned beverages, and other larger items. The dial thermostat, with seven temperature settings, is located in the front upper-right corner for easy temperature management.      

The SPR196OS is ENERGY STAR certified and designed for built-in or freestanding outdoor use. For a similar unit with a glass door, see the SPR489OS.

components.name: Hestan 42" Outdoor BI Grill (Mixed Burners) -Steeletto
components.description:
FEATURES
Patented heavy-duty Horizon Hood™ opens easily with spring-assisted hinges and holds place at desired height for easy access.
Patented Halogen Stadium Lights™ illuminate the entire cooking area with motion-activated under-hood lighting.
Patented ceramic infrared top burner delivers 12,000 to 18,000 BTUs – perfect for searing/finishing and cooking with the included rotisserie.
Patented Trellis Burner™ design delivers 25,000 BTUs of high-performance power with greater heat coverage and precision control.
Patented DiamondCut™ grates create a superior grilling surface and greater heat distribution with ultra heavy-duty 5/16″ stainless steel (lasered in-house).
Split-shelf warming rack (42" model only) features an upper shelf position for browning and melting under the infrared rotisserie burner, and a lower shelf position for keeping food warm.

774-square-inch primary grilling surface with 282-square-inch warming rack surface makes room for large cookouts.
Patented flip-to-clean radiant tray with monogrammed ceramic briquettes generates smoky flavor from drippings.
Concealed whisper-quiet rotisserie motor system features a chain-driven, single-speed, 6 rpm, 50 in-lbs motor.
Patented Marquise Accented™ control panel and hood handle with commercial-grade end caps.
Patented stainless steel DiamondCut™ warming rack is lasered in-house with three vertical positions and offers concealed storage when not in use.
One-push automatic ignition system fires up grill with a single click.
LED front control panel lighting makes controls easy to operate even at night.
Available in Natural Gas (NG) or Liquid Propane (LP).
Carbon fiber vinyl cover available.
High altitude kit available.
Trellis Burner™ conversion kit available.
Gas conversion kits (NG/LP) available.
Variable sear conversion kit available.
