components.name: 47 lb. Clear Outdoor/Indoor Icemaker
components.description:
Summit's commercially listed BIM68OS series icemakers are an attractive and durable solution to keeping a continuous supply of clear ice on hand in virtually any indoor or outdoor location.

Sized at 15" wide, the BIM68OSPUMP features a complete 304 grade stainless steel exterior specially built to hold up to the elements. The user-reversible door is designed with a powerful magnetic gasket to ensure proper insulation, with a stainless steel handle mounted horizontally for a modern look. The front-breathing design allows built-in installation under counters, while the fully finished stainless steel cabinet also allows freestanding use. The internal pump allows more flexibility in where you choose to place the unit. This unit has a sealed back to ensure added outdoor protection and easier cleanup.

The BIM68OSPUMP produces clear gourmet dice-style ice cubes, perfect for keeping any beverage cold without diluting the flavor. Under standard operating conditions, this unit can make up to 62 lbs. in a day cycle, while the storage bin can hold up to 26 lbs at a time. We include an ice scoop that can be hung inside for easy use. Frost-free operation eliminates the need to defrost the interior.

Designed and manufactured for us in South Korea, the BIM68OSPUMP is ETL-S listed to NSF-12 commercial standards for use in foodservice settings. The weatherproof constructed allows outdoor use, but this model can also be installed indoors in any kitchen or wet bar. A panel-ready version (BIM68OSPUMP) is also available.

NOTE: This unit requires professional installation. Drain hose and other connection equipment is not included.

components.name: 24" Wide Built-In Outdoor Beer Kegerator
components.description:
Summit manufactures a complete line of versatile kegerators capable of built-in installation in indoor or outdoor home settings.

The SBC683OSTRIPLE is a full-sized beer dispensers approved for both residential or commercial use. Sized at just 24" wide, it features a front-breathing system for built-in installation and a fully-finished cabinet that also allows freestanding use, with an included caster set for optional mobility. The exterior door and cabinet feature 304 grade stainless steel construction for safe, weatherproof use in the outdoors. The user-reversible door includes a pro style vertically mounted handle to complete the look. Additional features include a removable two-piece stainless steel drip tray to collect spills and a chrome guard rail to help keep glasses and mugs in place. This unit has a sealed rear for added protection from the elements.

Inside, the 5.6 cu. ft. interior can accommodate a full half or quarter keg, or up to three Cornelius or sixth barrel kegs. We include a complete commercial grade tap kit for dispensing your favorite beer, including a Sankey tap system and triple tap draft tower, along with a CO2 tank and regulator. A tap cool system keeps your beer cold as it goes through your tower, and a Velcro strap holds the tank in place. The floor is constructed from stainless steel for added protection when loading and removing kegs. Two chrome shelves, with six placement options, allow the kegerator to also function as a beverage refrigerator. A digital thermostat makes it easy to manage the wide range temperature, while the external digital display has a readout in Celsius or Fahrenheit. Automatic defrost operation ensures minimal user maintenance. The Memory IC function recovers the unit's last settings in the case of a power outage or disruption. 

With its solid construction, user-friendly features, and attractive design, the SBC683OSTRIPLE is the perfect beer dispenser for indoor or outdoor kitchens. Additional choices are available with alternate tapping options, including choices to dispense wine and coffee. Browse the full Summit line to explore all of your options.

components.name: Shallow Depth Indoor/Outdoor Beverage Cooler
components.description:
Summit's line of outdoor appliances includes slim-fitting display beverage centers designed for optimum storage and product presentation.

The SPR488BOS features a versatile design that meets NSF-7 and UL-471 commercial standards, but is also approved for residential use. Sized at just 19 inches wide and 17 inches deep, it features a jet black cabinet with a sealed back for safe installation in the outdoors. The user-reversible double pane tempered glass door includes a seamless stainless steel trim and a pro style handle. A factory installed lock offers added security, while the space-saving right angle plug and integrated hinge provide added flexibility in unit placement. Two leveling legs keep the unit level on uneven surfaces. 

Inside, the SPR488BOS utilizes an internal fan to ensure the interior is evenly cooled from top to bottom, while the automatic defrost system allows for minimal user maintenance. LED lighting allows full visibility of stored items in the jet black interior. Three adjustable glass shelves with six positions provide optimal storage capacity inside the 3.1 cu. ft. interior. The dial thermostat, with seven temperature settings, is located in the upper-right corner for easy temperature management.       

The SPR488BOS can be installed indoors or outdoors and is designed for built-in or freestanding use. For this unit in a lower ADA compliant height, see the SPR488BOSADA.

components.name: 30" Wide Built-In Indoor/Outdoor Combination Wine Cellar/Kegerator
components.description:
Summit's unique lineup of wine and beer refrigeration creates the perfect all-in-one solutions for home entertainment, with versatile built-in choices that can be used in indoor or outdoor kitchens. 

Model SWBC3041 is a french door combination wine cellar/kegerator, with two separate sections that let you keep wine properly stored and displayed while also serving beer on tap. The front-breathing design enables built-in installation under counters, while the fully finished stainless steel cabinet also allows freestanding use. We include a set of casters (two locking) for installation if using this cooler for more portable applications. The sealed rear and weatherproof exterior ensure safe use in outdoor kitchens.

The left side wine cellar zone features a stainless steel trimmed double tempered glass door to display your bottles in style. White LED lighting offers an attractive and efficient presentation. Adjustable wooden wine shelves let you store your bottles safely. 

On the right side, a fully featured kegerator is designed to let you serve beer from 1/6 (sixtel) sized kegs. We include all the tapping equipment you need, with a stainless steel draft tower and faucet, CO2 tank, and regulator. A removable guard rail and two-piece drip tray help you keep your serving area clean. 

Both units utilize intuitive digital controls with wide temperature ranges, letting you accommodate a variety of wine and beer styles for proper storage. Each door includes a pro style handle and factory-installed lock for added security as needed.

The SWBC3041 can be used in indoor or outdoor kitchens. With its professional design and versatile functionality, it's the ideal choice for home bars looking to please all beverage tastes.

components.name: 24" Outdoor 2-Drawer All-Freezer
components.description:
SUMMIT's outdoor collection of stainless steel drawer all-freezers combines the convenience of frost-free operation with the luxury of stainless steel to complete any outdoor kitchen in style.

The SPFF51OS2D comes in a convenient 24" footprint and can be used freestanding or built-in under counters. The cabinet and drawers are constructed from weatherproof stainless steel, with sleek handles to complete the look. An integrated Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter helps to protect the unit in the event of circuit breaks and the sealed back adds extra protection from the elements. We include an anti-tip bracket (installed by the user) for added safety.

Two sliding drawers offer convenient storage inside the 3.4 cu.ft. frost-free interior, with fan-forced cooling to ensure even temperature distribution. The drawers are fully constructed from stainless steel for easy cleaning and long-lasting use. Inside, a full-width sliding wire basket offers easy storage, while two adjustable dividers let you organize both the top and bottom drawer by separating the interior to accommodate a variety of items. Recessed LED lighting offers an attractive yet energy efficient look inside. The digital thermostat located in the stainless steel kickplate offers a readout in Celsius or Fahrenheit. Additional features include a Sabbath mode setting, temperature memory function, and audible alarms for high temperature fluctuations and open drawer alerts.

The SPFF51OS2D can be used in home or commercial settings. This unit is ETL-S listed to NSF-7 standards and meets UL Commercial Standard 471. For a matching outdoor all-refrigerator, see the SPR627OS2D.

components.name: 24" Wide Outdoor All-Freezer
components.description:
Complete any outdoor kitchen with SUMMIT's SPFF51OS, a frost-free all-freezer fully featured for versatile use.

Designed for built-in or freestanding use, the SPFF51OS comes in an easy fitting 24" width with a fully finished black cabinet. The reversible stainless steel door includes a factory installed lock and professional chrome handle.

Inside, the SPFF51OS includes user-friendly features for low maintenance operation. The frost-free design eliminates the need for manual defrosting and adjustable shelves offer storage flexibility. This unit also includes a digital thermostat and recessed LED lighting.

With a convenient size and user-friendly design, the SPFF51OS is the ideal addition to any outdoor kitchen. For a matching refrigerator, see the SPR627OS.

components.name: 24" Wide 2-Drawer All-Refrigerator
components.description:

Sized with a convenient 24" footprint, the SPR627OS2D can be built-in under counters or used freestanding. The cabinet and drawers are constructed from weatherproof stainless steel, with sleek handles to complete the look. An integrated Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter helps to protect the unit in the event of circuit breaks and the sealed back adds extra protection from the elements. Two sliding drawers offer convenient storage inside the 3.4 cu.ft. auto defrost interior, with fan-forced cooling to ensure even temperature distribution. The drawers are fully constructed from stainless steel for easy cleaning and long-lasting use. Inside, a full-width sliding wire basket offers easy storage, while two adjustable dividers let you organize both the top and bottom drawer by separating the interior to accommodate a variety of items. Recessed LED lighting offers an attractive yet energy efficient look inside. The digital thermostat located in the stainless steel kickplate offers a readout in Celsius or Fahrenheit. Additional features include a Sabbath mode setting, temperature memory function, and audible alarms for high temperature fluctuations and open drawer alerts.

The SPR627OS2D can be used in home or commercial settings. This unit is ETL-S listed to NSF-7 standards and meets UL Commercial Standard 471. For a matching frost-free freezer, see the SPFF51OS2D.

components.name: 24" Wide Outdoor All-Refrigerator
components.description:
SUMMIT's SPR627OS Series features built-in all-refrigerators equipped with user-friendly features for convenient use in any outdoor kitchen.

The SPR627OS is a 24" wide all-refrigerator that can be used built-in or freestanding in any outdoor or indoor location. It features a jet black cabinet and reversible stainless steel door with a professional style  handle. A factory installed lock offers added security.

Inside, this frost-free refrigerator includes an internal fan for an evenly cooled interior and a recessed LED light for an elegant yet energy efficient glow. The digital thermostat (located in the interior) allows you to adjust the temperature at the touch of a button. Adjustable glass shelves make it easy to organize the 4.6 cu.ft. interior. The floor is specially slotted to hold bottles in place. This unit has a flat door liner to accept larger trays. For optional door storage, add our SHELFKIT627.

With a stunning design and convenient features, SUMMIT SPR627OS is the ideal finish for any outdoor or indoor kitchen. For a matching freezer, see the SPFF51OS. This unit is ETL-S listed to NSF-7 standards for use in commercial establishments and is ENERGY STAR certified as a commercial refrigerator. It also meets DOE standards for residential applications, using 25% less energy than the maximum allowed for this product class and capacity.

components.name: 18" Wide Outdoor 2-Drawer All-Refrigerator, ADA Compliant
components.description:
Summit manufactures one of the industry's most extensive and unique selections of outdoor refrigeration, with weatherproof choices designed to bring user convenience and lasting durability to outdoor kitchens.

Sized at just 18" wide and 32" high, model ADRD18OS a two-drawer outdoor all-refrigerator that can be built-in under ADA compliant counters or used freestanding. Complete stainless steel construction inside and out is designed to hold up to the elements in style. Soft close glides allow you to gently close each drawer with a light touch. The drawers can also be customized with overlay panels to match or accent existing cabinetry design, while the stainless steel kickplate and stylish handles complete the look. This unit includes a right angle cord for a better fit. The sealed rear offers additional protection from outdoor elements. 

Frost-free operation ensures minimum user maintenance inside the 3.4 cu ft. interior. Each drawer includes a divider to make it easier to separate and organize your storage, with attractive and efficient LED lighting to illuminate the interior. Intuitive digital controls display a temperature readout switchable from Fahrenheit to Celsius to best suit your preference. High/low temperature alarms audibly warn if the interior goes out of the recommended range. Additional features include an open drawer alarm, child lock to secure the controls, sabbath mode for optional observance, and eco-mode for energy savings. 

Model ADRD18OS is ETL-S listed to NSF-7 commercial standards and also meets DOE guidelines for residential use. Additional outdoor drawer refrigerators and freezers are available, including 15" and 24" wide choices. Browse the complete Summit lineup for more options.

components.name: 24" Wide Outdoor All-Refrigerator, ADA Compliant
components.description:
Summit's shallow depth series of built-in undercounter refrigeration includes outdoor choices with weatherproof construction in a unique footprint.

Model SPR618OSADA is a 24" wide outdoor all-refrigerator sized under 18" deep. It comes in a 32" height to fit under lower ADA compliant counters, with adjustable legs and a sliding stainless steel kickplate cover that also allows you to raise the overall height up to 34" to fit standard counter spaces. The front-breathing system allows built-in installation, while the fully finished cabinet also allows freestanding use. Complete stainless steel construction on the exterior door and cabinet offer true luxury designed to last in the outdoors. This unit has a sealed rear and right angle cord for a better fit. The door is user-reversible and includes a front lock and pro style handle. 

Inside, the SPR618OSADA features stainless steel construction for improved durability and sanitation. Fan-forced cooling ensures even temperature distribution and fast temperature recovery. Recessed LED lighting offers an attractive yet efficient look. The digital thermostat makes it easy to manage the interior temperature. This unit includes cantilevered shelving in chrome for flexible storage. Additional features include an open door alarm, high temperature alarm, and Sabbath mode setting that lets you disable some of the electrical elements during periods of observance.

The SPR618OSADA refrigerator is ETL-S listed to NSF-7 commercial standards but can also be used in the home. With its deluxe style, user-friendly features, and uniquely shallow depth, this unit offers premium value for a variety of settings. Additional 18" deep choices are available in 15", 19", and 24" widths, including refrigerator drawers, wine cellars, beverage centers, and more.

components.name: 24" Wide Built-In Outdoor Drawer Refrigerator
components.description:
Summit manufactures an extensive selection of built-in refrigeration specially constructed for safe and reliable cooling in outdoor kitchens. 

The SDR241OS is a single drawer all-refrigerator that meets NSF-7 and UL-471 commercial standards and is also approved for residential settings. It's sized at just under 24" wide for an easy fit in standard cutouts, with a front-breathing design that allows built-in installation. The weatherproof construction allows safe use in outdoor settings, with a sealed back and fully finished black cabinet to ensure all components are protected from the elements. The drawer is constructed from 304 grade stainless steel, with a pro style handle and fully finished front. For more custom style, the drawer is panel-ready, allowing you to match or complement existing cabinetry in a few simple steps (panel dimensions: 15.6" H x 23.4" W at 3/4" maximum thickness).

Frost-free operation with fan-forced cooling ensures even temperature distribution with minimal user maintenance. A digital thermostat, located atop the refrigerator drawer, makes it easy to manage the temperature, with an LED display that can be read in Celsius or Fahrenheit. We include a removable clear cover that helps protect all components from the elements. To adjust the settings, slide the off to access the screen. 

Inside, the SDR241OS offers a full 2 cu.ft. capacity to accommodate your storage needs. Two removable dividers let you separate the drawer into one, two, or three zones to accommodate a variety of sizes. We also include a half-sized glass shelf. LED lighting affords a convenient view of store contents, while a child lock will disable the digital controls after two minutes of inactivity to prevent accidental adjustments. Additional features include audible alarms for high-temperature fluctuations and open drawer alerts, while a temporary memory function helps to recover all settings in the event of power loss. The Sabbath Mode setting disables certain electrical features during periods of religious observance.

With its fully-featured, weatherproof design, the SDR241OS is the perfect cooling compartment or beverage holder in outdoor or indoor home kitchens, as well as hotel spaces, foodservice areas, and more.

Note: Wood panel is not included. The images provided are meant only to be suggestive of what the product with a wood panel installed could look like. Users must supply their own wood panel.

components.name: 54" EAGLE ONE Super Premium Gas Grill with Black Glass Infrared Rotis Burner and Sear Zone, LP/NG
components.description:
54” EAGLE ONE SUPER PREMIUM GRILL - TE1BQ54RS

THE EAGLE ONE SUPER PREMIUM GRILL builds on our reputation of meticulous engineering, exceptional design and unparalleled performance.

The EAGLE ONE includes all of the premium features found on our C Series models plus the following exclusive features:

Ambient Illumination – A continuous layer of indigo blue light is cast down over the entire control panel. This elegant detail accentuates the beauty of the premium stainless steel.

Exact Control Illumination – A single LED above the control knob provides feedback from each burners dedicated temperature sensor. The LED changes color as the burner reaches warm, hot and searing temperatures in excess of 900º.

TempTrack™ illumination – A graduated series of LED’s indicates the average temperature from the burners to give you an overall grill temperature. You will know when your grill is ready to sear or cool enough to apply the cover after use.

Black Glass Infrared Rotisserie Burner – This sleek and concealed burner reaches higher temperatures and offers more variance from high to low. The glass enables the heat moving through it to be dispersed at a wider range, making it ideal for larger food items.

Chef Grade Hexagonal Grates – The extra-large 1/2” diameter hexagonal stainless steel rods have 50% more mass than most grates, providing more heat retention. The flat surface of the hexagonal rods provides more food to surface contact.

components.name: 4.5 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel Refrigerator
components.description:
Eco Friendly Lion Premium Grills Refrigerator - 2002

The Lion Premium Grills Refrigerator is environmentally friendly! Other refrigerators commonly use a refrigerant known as R-134a. Recent studies from the EPA and other scientific agencies have found this refrigerant to cause significantly more environmental warming than carbon dioxide per gram with a potential warming effect of 1,410. What does this mean exactly? It means that the release of one gram of R-134a is equivalent to the release of 1,410 grams of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere. In comparison, Freon 12, which was the most common refrigerant used throughout the 90’s, has a rating of roughly 8,500. In addition to these negative environmental impacts, many units emitted extremely harmful CFCs (chlorofluorocarbon compounds) which were common in refrigerators during this period of time.

The Lion Premium Grills Refrigerator uses R-600a as a refrigerant which has a potential warming effect of only 3 as well as causing no ozone depletion. This is significantly more environmentally friendly than previous refrigerants as the numbers show. At Lion Premium Grills, we strive to “go green,” minimizing our impact on the environment and maintaining quality of life standards by being eco-friendly. This is why our refrigerators also run on less electricity and our compressors are quieter, which not only benefits the environment but also actively saves money on monthly utility bills.

The fact that R-600a is environmentally friendly as well as meeting the highest standards as a refrigerant in it’s cooling properties, is more than enough for us to use it for our refrigerators.

components.name: Potomac Trail - Phantom Shadow
components.description:
Potomac Trail - Phantom Shadow

Potomac Trail offers a sophisticated look, which incorporates a wide range of stone sizes and includes both square- and rectangular-shaped stones. This style’s natural rough and smooth stone textures come together to create a balanced blend—enhancing any project.

- Mortarless stone veneer
- Lightweight composition
- Applicable for interior and exterior projects
- Installs with a finish nailer and finish nails
- Color-throughout proprietary material
- Moisture impermeable—will not hold moisture against structure
- Extremely durable, reducing breakage during shipping and installation
- Workability—can be cut to fit on-site 
- Performs extremely well under wind loading
- No effects when exposed to salt spray or freeze/thaw cycles
- UV resistant
- No specialized labor training required

components.name: Single Side Burner
components.description:
SINGLE SIDE BURNER - BSAF12D

The 12-inch single side burner drops into your outdoor kitchen space to gives you the capabilities of a traditional stovetop. The single burner is perfect for creating side dishes, preparing sauces, and sautéing veggies while you grill the main course. The knob gives you control of the burner with a maximum heat output of 12,000 BTUs. If installing the 12-inch single side burner into combustible material, you must first install an insulated sleeve.

components.name: Double Side Burner
components.description:
DOUBLE SIDE BURNER - BSABF12

The 12-inch double side burner slides into your outdoor kitchen space to gives you the capabilities of a traditional stovetop. Two knobs allow you to control the temperature of each burner individually, making it perfect for creating side dishes, preparing sauces, and sautéing veggies while you grill the main course. The double inch side burner reaches up to 24,000 BTUs between both burners. If installing the 12-inch double side burner into combustible material, you must first install an insulated sleeve.

components.name: Power Burner
components.description:
POWER BURNER - BSABW16

The 16-inch two-ring power burner slides into a built-in grill application. Two knobs individually control the temperature of the inner and outer cooking areas allowing up to 60,000 BTUs or down to 7,000 BTUs. The power burner allows you to quickly bring water to a boil. If installing the 16-inch power side burner into combustible material, you must first install an insulated sleeve.

components.description:
Nano LEGNA - WOOD (Copper) - FXMD-S-LRAM

- Oven floor size: 60×40 cm.
- The Alfa Forni pyrometer facilitates the accurate measurement of the temperature according to the type of cooking.
- The door comes with a peephole for continuously monitoring food cooking even when it’s closed.
- The cooking chamber is entirely made of reinforced stainless steel.
- The double layer of ceramic fibre insulation used in commercial ovens contains heat and prevents the external frame from overheating.
- To bake with the NANO oven, you just need small logs no more than 5 cm (2 in) thick. With 2 kg (4,4 lbs) of firewood you can really cook throughout the evening!
- Always use the wood basket so as not to overload the oven with logs and to better manage the food on the floor.
- The four oven floor firebricks are nearly 3 cm (1,2 in) thick to gradually absorb and release heat and to guarantee an impeccable cooking.
- 50 Kg (110 lbs) of made in Italy
- One minute to assemble it, one minute to cook!
- The “slide in-slide out” pizza peel allows you to make the most of your NANO oven cooking pizzas, bread and calzones.
